# Profile fiscal source parents

VITSTAT_TOTAL-2025.csv is the unchanged `TGES2025_Zipped/VITSTAT_TOTAL.CSV`
member of NJ DOE's 2025 TGES ZIP. It reports fiscal 2024. Its shares are
printed fractions, not percentages or inferred dollar amounts.

FY27_GBM_District_Details.xlsx is the unchanged FY2027 district-details
workbook. The header is Excel row 5. Totals and differences are not aid categories.

Both were acquired from NJ DOE on November 24, 2026; publisher URLs are in
inst/registry/sources.csv. Byte lengths and SHA-256 digests are in
fiscal-provenance.json. These small originals support offline acceptance.
Production continues to use the already declared package-owned GitHub Release
parents, checked by byte length and SHA-256 at every resolver read.
